title: LolPack
description: This texture pack adds new textures for weapons, tools, and armor to the game.
body: This texture pack breathes new life into the game by completely overhauling the visuals of weapons, tools, and armor. It replaces the default textures of the stone axe, wooden pickaxe, wooden sword, and netherite sword, along with many other items. Each piece of equipment gets a fresh, detailed look that enhances the overall aesthetic and makes your gear feel more unique and immersive during your adventures.
